text.p: Italian bond futures showed pared gains in late afternoon trading after U.S. Treasuries fell from the day's highs on profit taking while the lira weakened with little fresh news to direct trading, dealers said.
"BTPs are watching other markets particularly bunds and Treasuries with no clear influences today to trading," said one dealer on the LIFFE market.

Dealers say there is still a debate over when the Bank of Italy may cut interest rates with some seeing a move when May preliminary CPI data is released later this month or when the government's three-year target document is unveiled.

The BTP market had started firmer due to overnight gains in the U.S. market and early gains in bunds after Thursday's comment by Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan who said he expected growth to slow later in 1997 and into 1998 and warned the Fed would need to act if that does not prove to be the case.
